QuestionStmt.S:
Which of the following statements are correct?

A) $\alpha$ - amino acids present in protein is L - amino acid.
B) Amino acids contain $\mathrm{NH_2}$ as well as $\mathrm{COOH}$ group.
C) Number of amino group and carboxylic group are same in amino acids always.
D) Tyrosine was firstly obtained from cheese.

Choose the correct alternatives from below:

Solution.S:
The correct statements are A, B and D.

A) Proteins are made up of α-amino acids, and these amino acids generally have the L-configuration. So this statement is correct.

B) Amino acids contain both an amino group, —NH₂, and a carboxylic acid group, —COOH. So this statement is also correct.

C) The number of amino groups and carboxylic groups is not always the same in amino acids.

For example: Lysine has more amino groups, so it is a basic amino acid. Glutamic acid has more carboxylic acid groups, so it is an acidic amino acid. So statement C is incorrect.

D) Tyrosine was first obtained from cheese. Its name is also related to the Greek word for cheese. So this statement is correct.

Hence, the correct alternative is Option D: A, B and D only.
